name: Mura (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow embattled fess of the arms in the lower third and a yellow curved Greek cross patée at the centre of the upper part.
history: The flag was approved by the Generalitat on 7 February 2020 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 8062 of 12 February 2020; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with the yellow embattled fess of the arms of half, six and a half merlons in the lower third and the yellow curved Greek cross patée of the arms centred above.

features.role: embattled fess of six and a half merlons, 1/3 of the height
curved Greek cross patée of the arms, 1/3 of the height
